data.title: 小鞠知花 · 文学社百叶窗黄昏的原稿苦战
data.description: 黄昏阳光透过百叶窗，在文学社活动室旧长木桌上投下一道道温暖光栅。小鞠趴在散乱的原稿纸堆中，一手抓着铅笔一手抓挠额角，麻花辫微颤，拼尽全力构思小说情节。
data.location: nostalgic literature clubroom bathed in golden sunset stripes through wooden window blinds
data.action: slumped over cluttered wooden table strewn with manuscript papers, scratching ear with pencil eraser, pouting in adorable mental exhaustion
data.lighting: 百叶窗切割的暖橙夕阳条纹光束
data.promptProse: Chika Komari slumps over a table buried in manuscripts inside the literature clubroom, pouting in earnest frustration beneath sunset blinds.
data.animaCaption: Golden slatted light from the blinds falls over her scattered manuscript sheets as she ponders with her pencil.
